raw.title: 3. Preserve the scripted gait while repairing retention feedback
raw.hypothesis: An immutable scripted gait preserves contact coordination while a bounded symbolic residual repairs retention failures that whole-controller trace edits otherwise introduce.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is a contemporaneous unrestricted whole-controller edit given the same frozen gait and expert keyframes; a 0.20 fresh sustained-success gain would show that preserving the contact scaffold makes trace repair more effective.

protocol.command: gpu run bash -lc 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study gait_preserving_repair --stage 3 --block-seeds 4160 4161 4162 4163 --parity-seed 4164 --arms whole_edit,bounded_residual --repair-parent frozen_r039_gait --max-prefix-screen-episodes 120 --repair-variants 6 --screen-cases 10 --promotion-cases 30 --fresh-cases 30 --expert-cases 12 --model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1'
code_changes: Extend scripts/run_full_evolution.py with the displayed study arguments and a hash-checked resolver for the frozen R-039 gait; fail rather than substitute or retune a controller.

Share a cold exploration prefix between arms and fork only when the existing plateau trigger fires; cap prefix spending at 120 screen episodes plus one 30-case promotion evaluation per block. Do not weaken the trigger to obtain eligibility.

Give both arms the same gait source and 32 uniformly selected state-action keyframes from two expert demonstrations. Whole-edit may replace the controller; residual must retain the gait unchanged and add a componentwise bounded correction, capped at 0.15 of the normalized action range.

Keep both repairs within the existing 6-10 parameter interface, with six parameter-search variants and identical selection budgets. Keep bc_steps at zero and treat the gait as a non-fittable control scaffold, not a fittable-lane parent.

Freeze disjoint screen, promotion, prefix-probe, expert and fresh roles before running; retain promotion cases 10-39 and the existing sustained-success reducer. Qualify the expert on ten cases before exporting two demonstrations.

Budget at most 402 episodes per block: 150 prefix, 12 expert and 120 per continuation arm; add two separate 40-case parity controls. Permit at most one linked correction per LLM slot and run each Isaac cell in a separate process.

Unlike R-042's trace-selection comparison and deferred R-043's anatomical coordinates, this changes which existing contact dynamics an edit is allowed to destroy. Document residual saturation and any restriction-induced failures without changing the primary metric.

raw.falsified_by: With at least three eligible plateau blocks, the paired interval for residual minus whole-edit fresh incumbent success lies entirely below +0.20. An interval containing zero is not evidence of improvement; fewer than three triggered blocks make the repair comparison inconclusive.
raw.direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.
